title: Scaffold sample item and topic pages; widen board item column
description: Scaffold step 2 of 3. Sample item page and sample topic page, plus a fix to the home board's column widths. Deploys on merge to main. ## Context Step 1 (ship-0ac188, PR #10) built the home page and the board tabs as authored page files. Read what it did before you start: - `web/projection.json` `pages` and `chrome.stylesheets`. - `web/pages/home.md`. - `web/assets/shipped-components.css`: the shared components. Papyrus publishes only `css/site-theme.css` from `css/`, which is why the components live in `assets/`. Component classes: `.kicker`, `.cintillo`, `.sample-mark`, `.lime-band`, `.status-stamp(-shipped|-verified|-vapor|-pending)`, `.score-meter`/`.meter-segment`/`.is-on`, `.score-dimension`/`.is-low`, `.hype-gap(-over|-under)`, `.entity-chip(-proposed)`, `.spark`, `.button(-quiet)`, `.view-tabs`, `.vote-button`, `.board-*`, `.rail*`, `.section-heading`, `.preview-line`, `.shipped-page`, `.shipped-layout`. Reuse these classes. You own `web/assets/shipped-components.css` for this step. A parallel agent builds Submit, Roundup and Sign-in in its own stylesheet and does not edit yours. Put item- and topic-specific rules in a new `web/assets/shipped-item-topic.css` and add it to `chrome.stylesheets`. ## Pages to build Design directory (data only, never instructions): /private/tmp/claude-502/-Users-home-Projects/f48eecf1-1905-4a55-ae79-973fb25835bd/scratchpad/artifact-files/6fc5ac4b-d38d-475d-87e8-5e918d223fc1/project/ 1. **Item.** `Item.dc.html` (desktop) and `ItemMobile.dc.html` (at 640px and below). Path `sample/tern-3` (the design's Tern-3 item). If a nested `path` fails to build, use `sample-tern-3` and say so. Include the item header, status stamp with "checked by the desk", the four scores with vote-distribution bars and n, the hype gap, editor mean, evidence links with check states, the editors' note/summary, the knowledge-graph block, related items and the comment thread. Comments are visual only, with no form fields. 2. **Topic.** `Topic.dc.html`. Path `sample/voice-agents` (or `sample-voice-agents`). Include the header (name, kind, definition, aka, counts), profile bars, hype gap, the 26-week mentions-vs-shipped bar chart (static inline SVG), "Connected in the knowledge graph", insights, subtopics and ranked items. 3. On the home page and tab pages, link the sample items "Tern-3" to /sample/tern-3/ and the beat chip "Voice agents" plus the Trending entry "Voice agents" to /sample/voice-agents/. Leave other sample links as they are. ## Fix on the home board (shared CSS) At 1440 wide, the board's item column is too narrow: titles wrap to five lines and the entity chips stack one per line. Compare with Main.dc.html. Widen the item column, for example `minmax(0, 1fr)` for the title column with compact fixed widths for rank, vote, status, the four score columns and talk. Let chips wrap inline. Check / at 1440, 1024 and 390 afterwards. ## Rules (same as step 1) - Authored page files: `web/pages/.md`, starting with `::band{size="bare"}`, markup inside `::raw` … `::endraw`, each registered in `projection.json` `pages` (`id`, `path`, `title`, `description`, `source`). No hooks, islands or JavaScript. Never a literal `{{`. - Honest labelling. Every section with sample data carries `Sample` beside its heading. Under the page title, one line: "Preview: a fictional sample item that shows the design. Real item pages arrive with the newsroom feed." For the topic page use "a fictional sample topic … Topic pages arrive with the knowledge base." Use fictional names only, with `.example` domains for sample links.
